title: Semantic Data Charter governed data records
description: Collections of Governed Data Records, one per published Semantic Data Charter model, each described by the immutable schema its records conform to.

dataset.title: NHANES Participant governed data records
dataset.description: SDC4 data model for National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (nhanes_blood_pressure) — FAIR Data Demo. Each record is a governed data record conforming to the Semantic Data Charter model NHANES Participant (dm-xy8upneajsb8vdcmnve01g6g), published 2026-09-26. The schema is immutable and is the data dictionary: every variable's name, definition, datatype, units and permitted values, cited by URL and SHA-256 in describedBy and conformsTo.

landingPage.title: NHANES Participant in the public catalog

describedBy.title: SDC4 schema dm-xy8upneajsb8vdcmnve01g6g (NHANES Participant)
describedBy.description: The immutable schema every NHANES Participant record is validated against: 153 variables with their definitions, datatypes, units, enumerated values and codes, and the sixteen typed reasons a value may be missing.

dataset.versionNotes: A published Semantic Data Charter model never changes; a revision is a new model naming the one it revised (prov:wasRevisionOf).
